svg.text: Full system workflow | Human-reviewed AI research, evidence matching and outreach
Public web + careers | Public LinkedIn evidence / BDR input | EVOX customer stories + approved internal evidence
Sources, dates and confidence travel with each prospect
Unverified mandatory criteria -> Needs verification queue. Industry fit and evidence confidence are shown separately.
No reliable contact -> verified company LinkedIn page + manual search. No suitable story -> proceed without a customer claim.
BDR sends prospect outreach manually in the MVP
Validation failure -> revise the draft. No approval -> hold. Evidence changes -> return to the relevant BDR checkpoint.
Track status, follow up and escalate
Checked, pending -> email draft; verify address
Wrong contact -> return to contact discovery
Alert GM once per overdue record
BDR updates status -> resolve alert -> route again
Wrong contact: reopen Stage 2. No update before deadline: keep monitoring.
Late updates do not generate duplicate invitations.
Workflow controller + approval gates | Evidence store + approved claims | Account/contact database + audit log
All AI tasks call a configurable LLM API server-side. Tools retrieve evidence; the LLM interprets and drafts. Rules control timing and routing.
Solid arrows = workflow / handoff. AI agents are bounded tasks coordinated by one controlled workflow.
DESIGN SPECIFICATION - NOT MEASURED TEST RESULTS
